jobs.description:
At Baker Home Energy we thrive off of truly living our values - Do the Right Thing, Exemplify Our Reputation, Win Together, and Embrace Change and Growth.

SUMMARY
: The Project Coordinator II provides administrative, procedural, and systems support to ensure accuracy, timely execution, and successful progression of assigned projects. This role supports execution, tracking, and documentation throughout the lifecycle of the project.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Support & Execution

Provide day‑to‑day administrative and operational support to assigned projects
Track project milestones, schedules, and task completion to support adherence to established timelines and KPIs
Monitor project status and proactively identify missing information, risks, or delays for escalation to the Project Lead
Act as a support resource to ensure project continuity throughout project lifecycle and departments
Complete general and additional tasks as needed to support company operations.

Documentation & Systems Management

Prepare, submit, and maintain accurate project documentation including contracts, change orders, permits, lease agreements, rebates, and utility paperwork
Ensure all project activity, documentation, and milestone updates are accurately entered and maintained within designated project management systems
Maintain organized electronic project files to support reporting, audits, and project closeout

Internal Coordination

Coordinate with internal teams (Sales, Engineering, Permitting, Scheduling, Installations, Service, Finance) to gather required inputs and support task completion
Support jurisdictional, utility, and financing requirements through accurate submittal tracking and follow‑up
Communicate routine internal project updates to the Project Lead and relevant stakeholders

Utility, Leasing & Compliance Support

Submit, track, and manage utility applications and Permission to Operate (PTO) status
Track leasing milestones and financing timelines to ensure contractual and funding requirements are met
Submit, track, and manage jurisdictional requirements, inspections, and applicable rebates until completion

Technical & Closeout Support

Support monitoring portal setup and system configuration activities to assist with system energization when required
Assist with project closeout documentation and confirmation of completion milestones

Training, Process & SOP Ownership

Train and support Project Administrators on tools, processes, and expectations
Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for assigned responsibilities to support consistency and scalability
Provide and present opportunities for process improvement, efficacy and improved project timelines

Key 30, 60, 90 Day Accomplishments

First 30: Familiarize self with BHE processes and timelines, be able to work independently on multiple projects
First 60: Manage workflow, tasking, coordination and administration effectively
First 90: Fully trained, proficient in all assigned responsibilities, able to efficiently manage workload

Experience, Education

High school diploma or general education degree (GED) is required, some college preferred
2+ years of project coordination or management experience in solar industry
Proven experience leading the coordination of multiple projects with success.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, PowerPoint) and strong overall computer literacy.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-through skills.
Comfortable leading meetings, facilitating discussions, and driving action items to completion.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to learn quickly in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.

Technical Competencies

Electrical project complexity – solar, roofing, and basic energy storage
Ability to proficiently support various types of projects
Aptitude for broadening electrical knowledge

Behavioral Competencies

Communication
Customer Service
Collaboration
Flexibility/Adaptability
Problem Solving

Pay Transparency

Baker provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO). jobs.description:
Job Description

Dewberry is currently seeking a Geospatial Analyst III
for our Fairfax, VA or
Tampa, FL
office. Remote positions
will be considered dependent on experience. This is an excellent career opportunity for an individual to join a team of professionals while working in a multidisciplinary consulting and engineering firm. The firm succeeds through the individual and collaborative skills of its people therefore we offer opportunities for professional growth while working with and applying the latest technology. Typical responsibilities are to work on the GIS/IT and Remote Sensing related projects for state and federal clients across the US. Overall responsibility includes working on a team performing automated and manual processing of point cloud data.

Dewberry is a leading, market-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors are our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.

Responsibilities

Position requires experience in analysis and review of topographic lidar data, topobathymetric data, vector data (2D and 3D), Digital Elevation Models (DEMs), Digital Surface Models (DSMs), imagery, and derivative products for state, federal, and private clients across the US. Experience with creating automated lidar classification algorithms (TerraSolid Products) preferred. Strong candidates will also have a good, conceptual understanding of fundamental remote sensing concepts and geospatial processes for various products, e.g. how lidar sensors work, basic GPS ground survey procedures, airborne lidar trajectory processing, interaction of light and water for bathymetry applications, and ortho-imagery processing.

Working with the initial processing and data classification of multiple topographic and bathymetric lidar projects
Creating Scripts/Models/Macros in multiple sensor platforms
Work with the Product Line Lead to assist in the execution of projects, on time and within budget
Data Management and Handling: Planning and monitoring production data, management needs and working with IT and Operations to ensure adequate resources are available; Ensuring data management protocols are met including the use of proper files and formats as well as file locations, storage, and backups
Perform work that appropriately follows all quality control steps and practices are implemented throughout processes to ensure deliverables meet client specifications
Provide feedback and support for developing and/or updating SOPs as necessary
Works with production staff to support process improvements; working with other Technology/Process Improvement teams to review best practices to enhance product line, gain efficiencies, and improve quality
Support improvements to automation of the production and QC process through providing technical guidance and ideas
Task Management; Problem resolution; Report writing; Collaboration
Quality Assurance, documentation and providing feedback

Required Skills & Required Experience

Required Skills and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Geography, GIS, or related field.
3 +years of experience in the GIS/Remote Sensing Field or equivalent combination of education and experience with a focus on point cloud classification working with Lidar and producing other Elevation data sources
Experience in Lidar processing and elevation model creation/manipulation, hydrography, or other remote sensing processing, development, and QA/QC
An understanding of GIS and Lidar data and concepts including a strong knowledge of various raster and vector data types, coordinate systems, projections, and datums
Understanding of Lidar production workflow and being able to explain the conceptual basis of Lidar acquisition, processing, and deliverable creation
The ability to analyze point clouds and various geospatial data layers derived from point cloud data
Working experience with Terrasolid Products and MicroStation
In-depth knowledge of ESRI’s products including ArcGIS 10x, ArcPro.
Proficiency in basic computer applications, especially MS Office (Word, Excel, and Access)
Ability to handle multiple priorities under tight schedules as required
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Beneficial Skills & Experience

Creative problem-solving skills.
GISP Certification, ASPRS certifications in Lidar or other Remote Sensing technologies a plus
LASTools, LP360, Global Mapper, QGIS experience a plus
Working knowledge of Python and/or other programming languages a plus
GDAL Tools, and command line applications highly desirable
ArcGIS Data Review and Production Editing experience a plus
Specific experience working with Riegl topobathymetric sensors and Optech CZMIL topobathymetric sensors
Experience creating scripts/models/macros in multiple GIS/remote sensing platforms
Experience with national elevation programs, such as NOAA’s Coastal Mapping Program, USGS 3DEP, and/or USGS 3DHP
Experience with industry standards and specifications, e.g., ASPRS Positional accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data, USGS Lidar Base Specifications

Additional Requirements

US Citizen

So, if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the position description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to pass a driving record background check.

At this time, Dewberry will not sponsor a new applicant for work authorization.

These screenings will be conducted by Dewberry’s background vendor of choice and will be conducted in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local law.

Main Purpose/Focus of the Position: This position leads the Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS) program that produces and reports key economic data for Missouri, in partnership with the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). The Local Area Unemployment Statistics program publishes monthly estimates of labor force, employment, and unemployment statistics at the city, county, Micropolitan Statistical Areas, Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA), and state levels. This position ensures there is accurate, timely, and high-quality labor force data to support decision-making in Missouri.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Prepare and verify detailed statistical model data inputs.

Work with partners from other states to ensure quality and accuracy of cross-state data.

Create and review monthly and annual estimates of labor force data.

Work with the BLS Regional and National Offices to ensure data quality for the LAUS program and troubleshoot any program improvements, changes, or issues.

Use BLS data and work with Office of Workforce Development to create annual Areas of Substantial Unemployment.

Serve as a back up to other statistical programs, including Current Employment Statistics.

Use knowledge of state and local economic trends to collaborate on the accuracy and publication of the resulting data.

Respond to data requests as needed.

Effectively use a variety of programs such as Excel, Word, and proprietary program software to ensure program performance.

Perform other related work as assigned.

Demonstrate regular and reliable attendance.

Knowledge of statistical methods, data collection and dissemination, sample surveys, and quantitative analytical methods.

Ability to use dashboards and reporting tools to measure and guide performance.

Knowledge of economic, education, and labor market information data sets, sources and uses.

Ability to innovate, set strategy, and adapt as program needs evolve.

Beneficial education and/or work-related experience includes technical or professional experience in research, data analysis, economics, business, public administration, or closely related area, including military service.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

The Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring enterprise data is accurate, consistent, and trusted for decision-making. This role combines analytical expertise with data governance practices to support the effective use and management of data across the organization. Key responsibilities include profiling data, monitoring data quality, enforcing governance standards, and delivering insights that enhance business performance.

The analyst will work closely with the Data Product Owner, Data Engineering Lead, and various business teams to improve how data is accessed, maintained, and leveraged. This position plays a critical role in promoting data integrity, driving adoption of governance frameworks, and enabling data-driven decision-making.

Essential Functions:

Perform data profiling and quality assessments across critical systems: Analyzes datasets to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and patterns, ensuring data integrity and readiness for business use.
Monitor data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with governance standards: Implements ongoing checks and controls to maintain high-quality data aligned with organizational and regulatory requirements.
Develop and maintain business glossaries, metadata, and data dictionaries: Creates and updates documentation that defines key data elements, ensuring shared understanding and consistency across teams.
Partner with engineering and product teams to resolve data issues and enforce standards: Collaborates cross-functionally to address data quality concerns, implement governance policies, and support scalable data solutions.
Support audits, regulatory requirements, and compliance initiatives (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA where applicable): Prepares and provides data-related documentation and evidence to meet internal and external compliance obligations.
Build and deliver reports and dashboards that track data quality and governance KPIs: Designs visual tools to monitor performance metrics, enabling transparency and continuous improvement in data governance efforts.

Qualifications:

3–5 years of experience in data analysis, data governance, or data stewardship
Strong SQL skills and proficiency with BI tools such as Power BI or Looker
Familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA, DCAM)
Knowledge of data privacy, compliance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA)
Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and documentation capabilities
Excellent communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences

Experience:

Hands-on experience conducting data profiling and quality assessments
Experience developing and maintaining business glossaries, metadata, and data dictionaries
Proven track record of collaborating with engineering and product teams to resolve data issues
Experience supporting audits and compliance initiatives related to data governance
Demonstrated ability to build reports and dashboards that track data quality and governance KPIs

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities:

Deep understanding of data governance principles and best practices
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets
Proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools
Knowledge of regulatory frameworks and data compliance standards
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Skilled in identifying and resolving data quality issues across systems

Physical Demands: Must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer for extended periods of time.

Travel: Occasional shipboard travel when business requires.

Work Conditions: Work primarily in a climate-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential.

jobs.description:
Primary Function/General Purpose Of Position

The Community School Coordinator strengthens the bond between community schools and their surrounding community by positioning schools as a welcoming resource to students, parents, and community members. The position works collaboratively with school principals, partner agencies, and community members to co-design, implement, and manage all community school services at assigned schools. The Community School Coordinator employs an assets-based approach to the 21223 community as they build community partnerships, communicate available services, and coordinate various events that support the strategic vision of the Future Baltimore School Cohort. The position will co-create a refined community school strategy for six schools in the Bon Secours Baltimore footprint.

Employment Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
:

A bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Social Work, Business, Human Services, Human Resources, Education or equivalent from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience is required.

Two years of social service experience.

Organizational skills, record keeping skills, and time management skills

Proficient in in Microsoft Office Suite.

Effective verbal, oral presentation, and written communication skills.

Strong interpersonal skills necessary to develop and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.

Detail oriented with excellent critical thinking skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing multiple complex projects.

Experience working with youth, families, and community members from Title I schools.

Record of building partnerships between public agencies, private organizations, community residents, and funders in the non-profit and government fields.

Experience engaging community residents and parents in support services.

Experience using a racial equity framework to empower disinvested communities of color.

Essential Job Functions

Work with the Community Schools Program Manager, principals, school staff, students, and 21223 community residents to create a welcoming and supportive school environment for both students and the community at large.

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned principals.

Successfully coordinate the community schools needs assessment process at assigned schools by gathering community level data and conducting surveys of students, families, and staff. Manage the coordination and implementation of community partnerships used to support the needs identified during the community school needs assessment process.

Maintain an active list of resources and services that students, families, and community members can access.

Refers students and families to external community agencies and organizations when appropriate for specialized support.

Recruit, train, and manage school volunteers to further the success of individual schools and the outcomes of partnerships.

Employ data collection strategies for all initiatives implemented at assigned schools.

Submit a monthly reporting dashboard to each assigned principal to communicate services being provided and their outputs.

Submits timely weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual qualitative and quantitative reports on services as requested.

Support the Community Schools Program Manager in the evaluation of support services being provided at assigned schools.

Represents designated schools publicly, as requested, reporting on program successes and outcomes.

Establish a community school council comprised of school administrators, staff, students, community representatives and extended service partners, with the goal of identifying, coordinating, and brokering relationships for service delivery at the school.

Collaborate with Bon Secours Community Works other Community School Coordinators to allow for effective resource allocation.

Participate in professional development and capacity-building activities, including but not limited to trainings, meetings, workshops, and conferences.

Coordinate services and work plans with the other Future Baltimore Community School Coordinators.

Other related duties as assigned by the Family Support Center Director and Community Schools Program Manager.

Description

Alta Planning + Design seeks a Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)
for our Los Angeles

If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!

About Alta

Alta is a mission-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

Day to Day

Serve as a technical expert and analyst across various disciplines, project types, and regions. Develop prototypes of repeatable analysis in R, Python, and GIS to advance place-based sustainable transportation solutions. Over time, foster an entrepreneurial approach to analysis through staff training, research, tool development, and custom web applications.

Engage across Alta’s disciplines to understand data analytics needs, priorities, and expectations, fostering a data-informed decision-making culture. Lead the development of new analytical products that align with the firm's objectives and the multidisciplinary nature of the practice. Collaborate closely with planners, designers, and engineers in tasks related to data analysis and visualization, ensuring the developed solutions bring valuable mobility insights and can scale organization wide.

Delve into data analysis and visualization components of client projects and R&D efforts, employing complex methodologies. Address mobility and access challenges through innovative analytical solutions, and articulate data-driven narratives effectively through reports, technical memos, and presentations. Be proactive in identifying labor-intensive processes and analysis, exploring avenues to streamline and automate them to create organization-wide value Work on a range of projects including active transportation plans, safety action plans, complete streets planning, safe routes to school, new mobility plans, and economic benefit studies. Each day, you will keep a community-focused perspective by pushing forward solutions that help communities inform narratives about people, address multifaceted community goals, prepare communities for change, and build a more just transportation system.

Qualifications

Required

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative field with demonstrated experience in the transportation planning field, OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Planning, Landscape Architecture, Environmental Sciences, or Engineering with some experience in the software development and/or data science fields.
Proficiency in Python and/or R, SQL

A solid background in data analysis, cross tabulation, and data interpretation is essential. Candidates should be able to apply data driven techniques to inform evidence-based decision-making in planning and design contexts.
Strong understanding of databases, GIS, coding, and familiarity with transportation planning at an advanced level.

Experience designing, implementing, and documenting analytical solutions using code. Ability to execute an analysis entirely with code.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience using Deltek VantagePoint.

Alta Planning + Design seeks a Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)
for our Huntsville
office. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!

About Alta

Alta is a mission-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

Day to Day

Serve as a technical expert and analyst across various disciplines, project types, and regions. Develop prototypes of repeatable analysis in R, Python, and GIS to advance place-based sustainable transportation solutions. Over time, foster an entrepreneurial approach to analysis through staff training, research, tool development, and custom web applications.

Engage across Alta’s disciplines to understand data analytics needs, priorities, and expectations, fostering a data-informed decision-making culture. Lead the development of new analytical products that align with the firm's objectives and the multidisciplinary nature of the practice. Collaborate closely with planners, designers, and engineers in tasks related to data analysis and visualization, ensuring the developed solutions bring valuable mobility insights and can scale organization wide.

Delve into data analysis and visualization components of client projects and R&D efforts, employing complex methodologies. Address mobility and access challenges through innovative analytical solutions, and articulate data-driven narratives effectively through reports, technical memos, and presentations. Be proactive in identifying labor-intensive processes and analysis, exploring avenues to streamline and automate them to create organization-wide value Work on a range of projects including active transportation plans, safety action plans, complete streets planning, safe routes to school, new mobility plans, and economic benefit studies. Each day, you will keep a community-focused perspective by pushing forward solutions that help communities inform narratives about people, address multifaceted community goals, prepare communities for change, and build a more just transportation system.

Qualifications

Required

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative field with demonstrated experience in the transportation planning field, OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Planning, Landscape Architecture, Environmental Sciences, or Engineering with some experience in the software development and/or data science fields.
Proficiency in Python and/or R, SQL

Proficiency in Quantitative Analysis:
A solid background in data analysis, cross tabulation, and data interpretation is essential. Candidates should be able to apply data driven techniques to inform evidence-based decision-making in planning and design contexts.
Strong understanding of databases, GIS, coding, and familiarity with transportation planning at an advanced level.
GIS Proficiency - both open-source (PostGIS, QGIS, geopandas, etc.) and the ESRI suite (ArcGISPro, Spatial Analyst, Network Analyst, etc.).
Ability to create informative data visualizations through code (e.g. D3, ggplot, matplotlib, plotly, kepler.gl, etc.).
Experience designing, implementing, and documenting analytical solutions using code. Ability to execute an analysis entirely with code.
Data specifications & database acronyms like OSM, MDS, GTFS, GBFS, GPS, CDS don’t scare you.
Proficient in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, similar products.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred
There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to: Master’s Degree in Urban Planning, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Math, or Social Sciences
1+ years of experience in a consulting environment or public entity. You have experience working on responses to public sector requests for proposals.
AICP Certification.
Experience using Deltek VantagePoint.
Active participation in industry-relevant professional associations and committees.
Demonstrated work of applied statistics or machine learning techniques to transportation challenges.
Basic familiarity with deploying analytical solutions over the web with the use of Flask, Django, Fast-API, Tableau, PowerBI, ArcGIS Enterprise, or R-Shiny.

Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.

for our Fairfax, VA or

Strong candidates will also have a good, conceptual understanding of fundamental remote sensing concepts and geospatial processes for various products, e.g. how lidar sensors work, basic GPS ground survey procedures, airborne lidar trajectory processing, interaction of light and water for bathymetry applications, and ortho-imagery processing.

Experience in Lidar processing and elevation model creation/manipulation, hydrography, or other remote sensing processing, development, and QA/QC

Understanding of Lidar production workflow and being able to explain the conceptual basis of Lidar acquisition, processing, and deliverable creation
The ability to analyze point clouds and various geospatial data layers derived from point cloud data
Working experience with Terrasolid Products and MicroStation
In-depth knowledge of ESRI’s products including ArcGIS 10x, ArcPro.
Proficiency in basic computer applications, especially MS Office (Word, Excel, and Access)
Ability to handle multiple priorities under tight schedules as required
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Beneficial Skills & Experience

Creative problem-solving skills.
GISP Certification, ASPRS certifications in Lidar or other Remote Sensing technologies a plus
LASTools, LP360, Global Mapper, QGIS experience a plus
Working knowledge of Python and/or other programming languages a plus
GDAL Tools, and command line applications highly desirable
ArcGIS Data Review and Production Editing experience a plus
Specific experience working with Riegl topobathymetric sensors and Optech CZMIL topobathymetric sensors
Experience creating scripts/models/macros in multiple GIS/remote sensing platforms
Experience with national elevation programs, such as NOAA’s Coastal Mapping Program, USGS 3DEP, and/or USGS 3DHP
Experience with industry standards and specifications, e.g., ASPRS Positional accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data, USGS Lidar Base Specifications

US Citizen
